title: Vistra Earnings Offer Window Into Power Generation Ramp-Up for AI Data Centers
excerpt: US power use is expected to keep notching record highs in 2026 and 2027, according to the Energy Information Administration.
content_html:
Concerned about an AI bubble? Sign up for The Daily Upside for smart and actionable market news, built for investors.

Beneath the obvious AI hyperscaler stocks — Meta, Nvidia and so on — lies another layer of trades: the energy companies providing the power AI needs to, for instance, edit your ex out of the family photo. 

Vistra, one of the leading US power generators, reports this morning as it builds out capacity to meet the demand of AI giants. Rival power provider Constellation Energy meanwhile boosted its forecast for the year yesterday after reporting $7.5 billion in second-quarter sales.

Data Centers' Power Deficit

US power use is expected to keep notching record highs in 2026 and 2027, according to the Energy Information Administration. Data centers could suck up a fifth of the US's total electricity in 2035, up from about 6% today, BloombergNEF found. In states with more data centers, including Texas, that share is expected to be higher. The grid's already strained, and the record amount of capacity it's been able to supply to data centers in the past is just over 7 gigawatts a year (one gigawatt is roughly the equivalent of one nuclear reactor). BloombergNEF analysts expect the grid to come 19 gigawatts short of what data centers demand by 2035. 

To fill the gap, hyperscalers and power companies like Vistra and Constellation are trying to create sparks any way they can:

  • AI is sourcing its juice from both natural-gas and nuclear options. Earlier this year, Vistra struck a deal to buy Cogentrix Energy and its 10 gas-fired power plants for $4.7 billion and reached a 20-year agreement that'll see Meta buy power from some of Vistra's nuclear plants. 

  • Constellation Energy has forged deals to supply nuclear power to Meta and Microsoft. Constellation said in 2024 it plans to restart Three Mile Island, where the US's worst nuclear meltdown occurred. The power generated there will supply Microsoft.

Not Overnight: AI's demand could continue to outpace power providers' ability to meet it, straining the grid and pushing up electricity prices. When explaining Vistra's projections for how quickly it could increase its available power supply, president and CEO Jim Burke hedged investors' expectations this spring, saying, "The physical world takes much longer to develop than what people might imagine it takes."

担心人工智能泡沫吗？ 订阅 The Daily Upside，获取专为投资者打造的明智且可行的市场新闻。

在明显的人工智能超大规模股票（Meta、Nvidia 等）的背后，还有另一层交易：能源公司提供人工智能所需的电力，例如将你的前任从家庭照片中删除。

美国领先的发电商之一瑞致达 (Vistra) 今天上午发布报告称，该公司正在建设产能以满足人工智能巨头的需求。 与此同时，其竞争对手电力供应商 Constellation Energy 在报告第二季度销售额 75 亿美元后，昨天提高了全年预期。

数据中心的电力不足

根据能源情报署的数据，预计 2026 年和 2027 年美国用电量将继续创下历史新高。 BloombergNEF 发现，到 2035 年，数据中心可能消耗美国总电力的五分之一，高于目前的约 6%。 在包括德克萨斯州在内的拥有更多数据中心的州，这一比例预计会更高。 电网已经紧张，过去为数据中心提供的创纪录容量仅为每年 7 吉瓦多一点（1 吉瓦大约相当于一个核反应堆）。 BloombergNEF 分析师预计，到 2035 年，电网将比数据中心的需求少 19 吉瓦。

为了填补这一空白，Vistra 和 Constellation 等超大规模企业和电力公司正在尝试以各种方式创造火花：

  • 人工智能从天然气和核能中获取能量。 今年早些时候，Vistra 达成了一项协议，以 47 亿美元收购 Cogentrix Energy 及其 10 座燃气发电厂，并达成了一项为期 20 年的协议，Meta 将从 Vistra 的一些核电站购买电力。
  • Constellation Energy 已达成向 Meta 和微软供应核电的协议。 Constellation表示，计划在2024年重启三哩岛，这里曾发生过美国最严重的核泄漏事故。 那里产生的电力将为微软供电。

这不是一朝一夕的事：人工智能的需求可能会继续超过电力供应商的满足能力，从而给电网带来压力并推高电价。 今年春天，在解释瑞致达对增加可用电力供应的速度的预测时，总裁兼首席执行官吉姆·伯克(Jim Burke)对冲了投资者的预期，他说：“物理世界的发展时间比人们想象的要长得多。”
